events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reporting that attacks planned by Bin Ladin's al-Qa'ida may have been delayed by heightened US security, but planning continues; remainder excised.

Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports that al-Qa'ida attacks planned by Bin Ladin may have been delayed by heightened US security, but planning continues and the attacks are expected to occur soon.

relationships.detail: The brief refers to al-Qa'ida as Bin Ladin's organization.
relationships.quote: Attacks planned by Usama Bin L11din 's al-Qa'ida organization may have been delayed.by

key_claims: As of 2 July 2001 the CIA assessed that al-Qa'ida attacks planned by Bin Ladin may have been delayed by heightened US security.
The brief's title indicates planning for Bin Ladin attacks continued despite the delay.
Most of the brief's content is excised, so details of targets, timing and personnel are unavailable.
